join_rules: Rebrickable elements.csv lists an element of the part in the color; the element ID is the lowest numeric element whose design_id equals the part number (else the lowest listed).
Rebrickable colors.csv gives the Rebrickable name, id and RGB; transparent colors are excluded.
LDraw LDConfig.ldr gives the LEGO name and id: the LDraw CODE equals the Rebrickable id, the names agree (case-insensitive, '_' as space, grey as gray) and a LEGOID comment precedes it.
The BrickLink color guide lists a color with exactly the Rebrickable name; its id is used.
BrickLink's pinned catalog page for the part (4073 plate, 98138 tile) lists the color with the same BrickLink id.
Kit colors are copied from kit_colors.json, the authority for them.

part_numbers.6141: Rebrickable elements.csv files element 614101 (and every other 1x1 round plate element) under part_num 6141 with design_id 6141; it lists no elements under 4073. BrickLink files the part as item 4073 with 6141 as an alternate number (pinned BrickLink catalog page bricklink-4073). Marketplace numbers: part_numbers.json.
part_numbers.98138: Rebrickable elements.csv files the 1x1 round tile under part_num 98138 (design_id 35381 for newer elements); BrickLink item 98138 (pinned page bricklink-98138). Marketplace numbers: part_numbers.json.
